Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/final/case-30001.json runs/final-case-30001-r3

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli start --case ../data/cases/final/case-30001.json --run runs/final-case-30001-r3
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30001-r3

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30001-r3 --slot 2 --why "Slot 2 gives near-max separation for the leading pair candidate 0 versus candidate 4 while also discriminating several other live pairs, and it is the earliest slot achieving that separation"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30001-r3

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30001-r3 --slot 6 --why "Slot 6 is the earliest reachable slot giving near-max separation for both the candidate one versus two pair and the candidate zero versus two pair, the two strongest surviving pairs"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30001-r3

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30001-r3 --slot 22 --why "Slot 22 is the earliest of the top discriminating slots for the sole remaining live pair candidate zero versus candidate one"

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30001-r3 --slot 29 --why "Confirmation observation at the earliest high separation slot for the still dominant candidate zero versus candidate one pair before finalizing, since candidate one crossed above candidate zero after only one prior observation"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30001-r3

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30001-r3 --slot 36 --why "Candidate one leads but is just under the resolution threshold, and the remaining live pair is candidate one versus candidate two, so I take the earliest slot that best separates that pair"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30001-r3

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30001-r3 --slot 38 --why "Final budgeted observation at the earliest slot that best separates both remaining live pairs to push the leading candidate past the resolution threshold if the data supports it"

content.text: Candidate 1 (period ≈19.35 d) resolved at support 0.999995, well above theta=0.997. Budget exhausted — finalizing.
